messages:
Zoe: kicking off a bring-up for v3-lite-int4-compact in staging. goal: aggressive cost savings w/ minimal quality delta. i'm drafting canary rules and want feedback before scheduling.
Sanjay: main ask: add an overlap/top-k token parity metric for structured outputs. int4 often shuffles top tokens and breaks code snippets.
Zoe: good point. propose top3-token-preservation >= 0.87 relative to baseline. add fidelity bucket for "code" vs "prose".
Kevin: we should also track embedding drift for retrieval pipelines. even small semantic shifts break rerankers. threshold: centroid-cosine-drop <= 0.02.
Li: agree. plus add a "siren" threshold: if hallucination delta >0.02 OR top3 <0.8 then immediate emergency rollback (no quarantine).
Zoe: ok siren mode is hard-fail. for other failures: standard fail -> rollback; low-sample anomalies -> quarantine-shadow.
Sanjay: sample gating? i'd require >=2500 samples and >=350 unique users per stage. sliding 15m for 1% stage, 60m for others.
Zoe: stage plan: 0.5% for 30m (smoke), 2% for 60m, 10% for 2h, 50% for 2h, 100% with escrow. escrow: keep 7% pinned to previous for 72h.
Kevin: can we capture kv-warmup hit-rate and prefix-cache efficacy as metrics? add min_kv_warmup_hit_delta >= -0.05 (i.e., can't drop more than 5%).
Li: and add a manual-gate at 50%: autopromote disabled beyond 50% until an engineer approves inside the console. helps catch slow regressions.
Zoe: draft rollout payload below (will paste to orchestration):
```json
{
  "policy":"phased",
  "stages":[{"pct":0.5,"duration_mins":30},{"pct":2,"duration_mins":60},{"pct":10,"duration_mins":120},{"pct":50,"duration_mins":120},{"pct":100,"duration_mins":0}],
  "checks":{"min_samples":2500,"min_unique_users":350,"metrics":{"hallucination_abs_delta":0.02,"mrr_rel_drop":0.01,"p95_latency_multiplier":1.25,"token_cost_multiplier":0.9,"top3_token_preserve_rel":0.87,"embedding_centroid_cosine_drop":0.02,"kv_warmup_hit_drop":0.05},
  "siren":{"hallucination_abs_delta":0.02,"top3_token_preserve_rel":0.8}
  },
  "escrow":{"pct":7,"duration_hours":72},
  "manual_gate_pct":50,
  "quarantine_shadow":{"enabled":true,"route":"shadow","alerts":["eng-sre","product"]}
}
```
Sanjay: bump token_cost_multiplier <1.0 ? interesting, means cheaper. make sure billing hook is tested.
Zoe: yes v3-lite should be cheaper; monitoring will validate. deploy-bot can run a mixed shadow with 20k requests including long-context and code prompts.
Zoe: @deploy-bot schedule mixed-shadow v3-lite-int4 --samples=20000 --cohorts=code,long,short --hooks=telemetry,embeddings,kv
deploy-bot: Job queued: id=rs-2026-04-09-11. results will be stored at /canary/results/1798887776. I will post a summary and raw artifacts when complete.
Kevin: after artifacts, let's do the human audit: 100 random diffs (50 code, 50 long) and a small embedding centroid heatmap.
Li: I'll coordinate with product/safety for the qual review and pre-authorize manual gate approvers.
Zoe: thanks. i'll open the rollout PR and attach the shadow job id. auto-fallback enabled for siren events; quarantine for low-sample anomalies.
Sanjay: perfect. ping here when shadow starts.
